comment: Known results of boot-test.py in a QEMU virt guest with no Apple hardware. Every entry needs a reason; remove an entry when the module loads cleanly (the test lists those).

skip.kernel/kernel/rcu/rcutorture.ko: starts an RCU torture run that keeps going until the module is unloaded
skip.kernel/sound/drivers/snd-mtpav.ko: claims a fixed legacy MIDI port and interrupt; request_threaded_irq() warns on arm64 machines that have no such interrupt

kernel/drivers/usb/atm/xusbatm.ko.reason: refuses to load without its vendor and product module parameters

kernel/drivers/ptp/ptp_kvm.ko.reason: needs the KVM PTP clock service, which the test guest does not offer

kernel/net/6lowpan/nhc_ghc_ext_dest.ko.reason: RFC 7400 compression registers the same next-header ID as the RFC 6282 module loaded before it
